questions.question: When Joab heard that Abner had visited King David and left in peace, what did Joab do?

answers.text: Demanded to know why David let Abner go
Thanked David for making peace with Abner
Handed David the plunder from the raid

questions.question: Before killing Abner, Joab pulled him aside into the gateway at Hebron. How did Joab make it look?

answers.text: As if he wanted to talk privately
As if he had a message from David
As if he was taking Abner to the king

questions.question: After Joab murdered Abner, King David asked the LORD to forgive Joab and his father's house. True or false?
When the people urged King David to eat something while it was still day after Abner's death, what did David do?

answers.text: Swore not to eat before sunset
Ate with the people to comfort them
Ate a little to keep his strength
